import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class cf723b {
    static final Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);

    static int[] documentAnalyser(String doc) {
        // Words outside parentheses: remove all parenthesized parts
        String outside = doc.replaceAll("\\([^)]*\\)", "");
        Pattern word = Pattern.compile("\\p{L}+");
        Matcher m = word.matcher(outside);
        int longest = 0;
        while (m.find()) {
            int len = m.group().length();
            if (len > longest) longest = len;
        }

        // Words inside parentheses: extract each parenthesized part
        int wordsInside = 0;
        Matcher paren = Pattern.compile("\\(([^)]*)\\)").matcher(doc);
        while (paren.find()) {
            String inside = paren.group(1);
            Matcher m2 = word.matcher(inside);
            while (m2.find()) {
                wordsInside++;
            }
        }
        return new int[]{longest, wordsInside};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        String s = sc.next();
        int[] res = documentAnalyser(s);
        System.out.print(res[0] + " " + res[1]);
    }
}

    enum State { OUTSIDE, INSIDE }

    static int[] documentAnalyser(String doc) {
        State state = State.OUTSIDE;
        boolean lastWasLetter = false;
        int longest = 0;
        int curLen = 0;
        int words = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < doc.length(); i++) {
            char c = doc.charAt(i);
            switch (c) {
                case '(':
                    state = State.INSIDE;
                    lastWasLetter = false;
                    curLen = 0;
                    break;
                case ')':
                    state = State.OUTSIDE;
                    lastWasLetter = false;
                    curLen = 0;
                    break;
                default:
                    if (Character.isLetter(c)) {
                        if (state == State.INSIDE && !lastWasLetter) {
                            words++;
                        } else if (state == State.OUTSIDE) {
                            curLen++;

                        }
                        lastWasLetter = true;
                    } else {
                        lastWasLetter = false;
                        curLen = 0;
                    }
            }
        }
        return new int[]{longest, words};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int length = sc.nextInt();
        String data = sc.next();
        int[] result = documentAnalyser(data);
        System.out.print(result[0] + " " + result[1]);
